text:
sam: heads up - hit a weird SDK edge with the TS client + toolcall. When a tool schema has a boolean | string union the SDK is sending booleans as strings after a retry. Repro below.

leah: ugh. any error logs or small repro?

sam: minimal repro:
```ts
// using @redwood/sdk-ts helper wrapper
const res = client.callTool('set_flag', { flag: true });
// network error -> retry -> server sees { flag: "true" } (string)
```
No middleware on our side. Happens consistently if the first call errors and the retry fires.

ravi: do you mean union schema like: `flag: boolean | "on" | "off"`?

sam: yeah exactly. server schema expects boolean OR specific strings. If original payload is boolean it arrives fine, but after the SDK retry flow it stringifies booleans. Looks like somewhere we stringify payload for the retry delay timer.

alex: that sounds like the retry wrapper doing `JSON.stringify` on args then reusing that string instead of re-serializing the original object. I saw a similar smell in an unrelated numeric-array fix but not with unions.

sam: i added logs from the client: first attempt payload: `{"flag":true}` second attempt payload: `{"flag":"true"}`

leah: can you paste the exact SDK call stack/log that triggers the retry? which transport (fetch/node-http)

sam: Node fetch (server-side). stack: SDK -> retry-wrapper -> backoff.timer -> transport. repro: turn off network for first 100ms with tc/netem and then allow.

ravi: thanks. assigning to @sdk-team. this might break structured-output tests in a few sample apps.

ci-bot: test failure detected: samples/feature-flags e2e (integration) — 1 test failing (toolcall-boolean-union.test.ts)

alex: good catch by CI. test shows server validation rejects payload in retry path.

leah: proposed fix: make retry wrapper preserve original args object (use shallow clone before serializing for delay) and ensure we re-run serializer at send-time. also add unit test for unions and for streaming toolcall.

sam: i can put up a draft PR today. will add a regression test (ts-sdk + node fetch) and a fix in retry-wrapper.

ravi: also add an e2e that toggles network and asserts server received boolean type. CI should cover it.

sdk-team: acked. please include changelog note under "fix: ts-sdk retry preserves value types for toolcall payloads" and mention sample that was failing.

leah: quick patch idea: in retry-wrapper, do `const payload = typeof args === 'string' ? args : JSON.stringify(args); await send(payload)` but for retries store the raw args, not the string. simple but needs tests.

sam: that matches my fix locally. one nuance: we also have a streaming mode where body chunks are created; make sure that path re-serializes pieces rather than reusing concatenated string.

alex: flagging for release notes. after PR we should run canary on dedicated infra.

sam: PR: draft -> #3421, added tests, CI passing locally. raising for review @leah @ravi.

leah: reviewing now. thanks for quick turnaround. :thumbsup:

ravi: once merged, i'll backport a minimal fix to v1.2.x since some customers on dedicated are on that branch.

sam: ping me if you need more repro logs or a tiny script to run with tc. happy to help.

ci-bot: linked issue #6789 created: "ts-sdk: retry coerces boolean to string for toolcall unions"

sdk-team: moving to in-progress. will include test matrix for fetch/node/http/sse.

sam: oof one more note — the sample app that failed uses a schema with `flag?: boolean | 'auto'`. optional + union + undefined path also had a serialization quirk in my local tests. added that case to the regression suite.

leah: perfect. let's keep the thread here for coordination. once backport and canary are green we can close #6789.
